summary: Toro Corp., a Cyprus-incorporated foreign private issuer in deep-sea freight, furnished a Form 6-K with Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2: unaudited consolidated interim financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the six months ended June 30, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed; the exhibits are incorporated by reference into the company's existing Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements. The filing is a routine periodic financial reporting event, not a special situation; watch only for follow-on capital-markets activity under the referenced shelf.
